claims.statement: Hardens the candidate-only QIS agent harness in three rounds on top of 8794a8f9877f01ee5a040b8d897574c3563db7ad. Input integrity: validate_qis_harness.py now parses receipts strictly, rejecting duplicate object keys and NaN/Infinity constants, and reports unreadable, malformed, missing or out-of-repository receipts as a structured fail-closed summary instead of a traceback. Semantic edge cases: duplicate command names are rejected and the git ancestry check is bounded by a timeout that fails closed. Workflow process: the harness receipt builder anchors on the final unittest summary line, so a stray OK, a trailing traceback, NO TESTS RAN or a missing log can no longer produce a passing or schema-invalid receipt; malformed or partial conformance output yields REVISE; checkout no longer persists credentials. Local verification on Python 3.12: 49 focused tests, 235 repository tests, 36/36 Intent Shaper conformance cases, valid provenance fixture with zero errors; the new tests were confirmed to fail (14 failures, 2 errors) against the previous evaluator and workflow. The valid provenance fixture's pinned materials are unchanged. This records local verification only; hosted CI, admission, runtime authority, deployment and merge are not established.
